pure-announcement.rationale: Reference documentation for a shipped feature, not a launch, release note or funding post.

duplicate.rationale: remote-first-mcp-governance and code-mode-mcp already cover the governance architecture and the search/execute pattern at concept altitude, but a reader of those learns the tool-namespacing scheme, transport fallback order, context-optimization modes and gateway DLP mechanics only here.

unfalsifiable.rationale: Every mechanism is specified concretely — API bodies, URL formats, error codes, limits — and checkable against the product.

durability.rationale: Dominated by dashboard paths, API field names, current limits (40 servers, 24-hour sessions) and already-churned surfaces (the 'Agents Gateway' rename, the deprecated allow_code_mode field) that will shift well inside twelve months.

actionability.rationale: Thoroughly actionable, but almost entirely as Cloudflare-specific dashboard, API and Terraform steps rather than decisions that transfer to other stacks.

atomicity.rationale: It bundles several standalone-capable mechanisms — the aggregation-portal pattern, tool namespacing and alias precedence, the minimize_tools/search_and_execute context-optimization modes, Code Mode policy, and DLP inspection of proxied MCP traffic — each of which could be its own concept.
